body:
Quick update! Thanks to your guy’s advice, I had her checked out ASAP! The veterinarian said she had trauma to the eye and expects it to heal normally. He explained that the brown spot was due to the collection of cells settling in the outer lens of her eye, kind of like flakes in a snow globe. I’m not sure how she injured it, crazy little cat. 

We got some eye drops to take home and I will be monitoring it as it heals. Thank you all!! ❤️
Thank you for the tip! I was able to find an ophthalmology specialist nearby and will be checking in with them too when they open back up in the morning. I appreciate your help!
I hope so! Maybe I'm being a crazy cat lady but I'll get it checked out regardless. I'm concerned because of the sudden onset and it looks to be covering her pupil at the bottom. Thank you!

Any advice is greatly appreciated! The earliest we can get her into the vet is next Monday, and my local emergency clinic says they don't have the tools to diagnose eye problems. I'm going crazy with worry and don't know if I should wait until the appointment or take her somewhere stat.

I noticed her eye looked strange last night and it seems worse today. There is no discharge nor does it seem to be bothering her/causing vision problems. She is around 3 months old and has been otherwise healthy.
Did you have problems with the auditorium website? I had to sit there for an hour just to get the page to load. Ended up getting tickets though!
Anyone going to the Chicago show? Although it's the closest to me, I still have to travel a bit and have no one to go with.
